PGIM Jennison Small Company Fund reported strong Q2 2026 returns while lagging the Russell 2500 Index. Read the full analysis for more details.

Summary Despite ongoing conflict in the Middle East, the Russell 2500 Index surged 20.3%. PGIM Jennison Small Company Fund generated a strong return but underperformed the 20.3% return of the Russell 2500 Index. Gulfport Energy declined during the quarter as weaker natural gas prices pressured sentiment across the sector. The setup for the remainder of 2026 remains constructive for small and mid-caps.
